Singularity.idealOrd_span_singleton.type:

Singularity.initialForm_mul.type:

Singularity.initialForm_ne_zero.type:

Singularity.isNormallyFlatAt_maximalIdea.type:

Singularity.isSncAt_top.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsRegularLocalRing R], Singularity.IsSncAt ⊤

Singularity.isSncDivisor_of_codim_one.type:

Singularity.killVar.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → [DecidableEq σ] → σ → MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k

Singularity.killVar_chartTransform.type:

Singularity.killVar_comp_chartRest.type:

Singularity.le_degree_of_mem_support.type:

Singularity.le_idealOrd.type:

Singularity.le_idealOrd_iff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)} {n : ℕ},

Singularity.le_idealOrd_mul.type:

Singularity.le_ord_add.type:

Singularity.le_ord_iff.type:

Singularity.le_ord_iff_mem_pow.type:

Singularity.le_ord_mul.type:

Singularity.le_ord_pow.type:

Singularity.le_ord_smul.type:

Singularity.mem_idealOfVars_iff.type:

Singularity.ord_add_pow_le_ord_cleanPart.type:

Singularity.ord_def.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : MvPolynomial σ R), Singularity.ord f = (↑f).order

Singularity.ord_eq_iInf_degree.type:

Singularity.ord_eq_top_iff.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {f : MvPolynomial σ R}, Singularity.ord f = ⊤ ↔ f = 0

Singularity.ord_le.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {d : σ →₀ ℕ},
  f.coeff d ≠ 0 → Singularity.ord f ≤ ↑(Finsupp.degree d)

Singularity.ord_le_of_pointChart.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {f f' : MvPolynomial σ k}
  {m : ℕ}, Singularity.ord f = ↑m → (Singularity.pointChart j t) f = MvPolynomial.X j ^ m * f' → Singularity.ord f' ≤ ↑m

Singularity.ord_le_ord_aeval.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {τ : Type u_3} (φ : σ → MvPolynomial τ R),
  (∀ (i : σ), MvPolynomial.constantCoeff (φ i) = 0) →
    ∀ (f : MvPolynomial σ R), Singularity.ord f ≤ Singularity.ord ((MvPolynomial.aeval φ) f)

Singularity.ord_le_ord_cleanPart.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (q : ℕ) (F : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.ord F ≤ Singularity.ord (Singularity.cleanPart q F)

Singularity.ord_le_ord_killVar.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (g : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.ord g ≤ Singularity.ord ((Singularity.killVar j) g)

Singularity.ord_le_ord_linearChange.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] (A : Matrix σ σ R) (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  Singularity.ord f ≤ Singularity.ord ((Singularity.linearChange A) f)

Singularity.ord_le_residualOrder.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] {q : ℕ},
  q ≠ 0 → ∀ (F : MvPolynomial σ k), Singularity.ord F ≤ Singularity.residualOrder q F

Singularity.ord_le_totalDegree.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {p : MvPolynomial σ k}, p ≠ 0 → Singularity.ord p ≤ ↑p.totalDegree

Singularity.ord_linearChange.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq σ] (A : Matrix σ σ R)
  [Invertible A] (f : MvPolynomial σ R), Singularity.ord ((Singularity.linearChange A) f) = Singularity.ord f

Singularity.ord_monomial.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {d : σ →₀ ℕ} {c : R},
  c ≠ 0 → Singularity.ord ((MvPolynomial.monomial d) c) = ↑(Finsupp.degree d)

Singularity.ord_mul.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] (f g : MvPolynomial σ R),
  Singularity.ord (f * g) = Singularity.ord f + Singularity.ord g

Singularity.ord_ne_top.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {f : MvPolynomial σ R}, f ≠ 0 → Singularity.ord f ≠ ⊤

Singularity.ord_neg.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] (f : MvPolynomial σ R), Singularity.ord (-f) = Singularity.ord f

Singularity.ord_one.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [Nontrivial R], Singularity.ord 1 = 0

Singularity.ord_pow.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] [Nontrivial R] (f : MvPolynomial σ R)
  (n : ℕ), Singularity.ord (f ^ n) = n • Singularity.ord f

Singularity.ord_prod.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] [Nontrivial R] {ι : Type u_3} (s : Finset ι)
  (f : ι → MvPolynomial σ R), Singularity.ord (∏ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, Singularity.ord (f i)

Singularity.ord_zero.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R], Singularity.ord 0 = ⊤

Singularity.orthant_add_orthant.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1}, Singularity.orthant σ + Singularity.orthant σ = Singularity.orthant σ

Singularity.p1Structure.type:
(k : Type u) →
  [inst : Field k] →
    (p n : ℕ) → (g : MvPolynomial (Fin n) k) → Singularity.P1Hypersurface k p n g ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec ↧k

Singularity.p1_equation_ne_zero.type:
∀ {k : Type u} [inst : Field k] {p n : ℕ},
  p ≠ 0 → ∀ (g : MvPolynomial (Fin n) k), MvPolynomial.X none ^ p + (MvPolynomial.rename some) g ≠ 0

Singularity.pointChart.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring k] → [DecidableEq σ] → σ → (σ → k) → MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k

Singularity.pointChartZ.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} →
    [inst : CommSemiring k] → [DecidableEq σ] → σ → (σ → k) → MvPolynomial (Option σ) k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial (Option σ) k

Singularity.pointChartZ_purelyInseparabl.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {q : ℕ}
  {F F' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  (Singularity.pointChart j t) F = MvPolynomial.X j ^ q * F' →
    (Singularity.pointChartZ j t) (Singularity.purelyInseparable q F) =
      MvPolynomial.X (some j) ^ q * Singularity.purelyInseparable q F'

Singularity.pointChartZ_rename.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k)
  (F : MvPolynomial σ k),
  (Singularity.pointChartZ j t) ((MvPolynomial.rename some) F) =
    (MvPolynomial.rename some) ((Singularity.pointChart j t) F)

Singularity.pointChart_X_eq.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k) (i : σ),
  (Singularity.pointChart j t) (MvPolynomial.X i) = MvPolynomial.X j * (Singularity.chartRest j t) (MvPolynomial.X i)

Singularity.pointChart_X_of_ne.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {j i : σ} (t : σ → k),
  i ≠ j → (Singularity.pointChart j t) (MvPolynomial.X i) = MvPolynomial.X j * (MvPolynomial.X i + MvPolynomial.C (t i))

Singularity.pointChart_X_self.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k),
  (Singularity.pointChart j t) (MvPolynomial.X j) = MvPolynomial.X j

Singularity.pointChart_eq_sum.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k) (f : MvPolynomial σ k),
  (Singularity.pointChart j t) f =
    ∑ a ∈ f.support,
      MvPolynomial.X j ^ Finsupp.degree a * (Singularity.chartRest j t) ((MvPolynomial.monomial a) (f.coeff a))

Singularity.pointChart_injective.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k),
  Function.Injective ⇑(Singularity.pointChart j t)

Singularity.pointChart_monomial.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k) (a : σ →₀ ℕ) (c : k),
  (Singularity.pointChart j t) ((MvPolynomial.monomial a) c) =
    MvPolynomial.X j ^ Finsupp.degree a * (Singularity.chartRest j t) ((MvPolynomial.monomial a) c)

Singularity.pointChart_ne_zero.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {f : MvPolynomial σ k},
  f ≠ 0 → (Singularity.pointChart j t) f ≠ 0

Singularity.pointChart_zero_comp_chartLi.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k),
  (Singularity.pointChart j 0).comp (Singularity.chartLinear j t) = Singularity.pointChart j t

Singularity.pow_eq_zero_of_isClean.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar k p] (e : ℕ) {F h : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.IsClean (p ^ e) F → Singularity.IsClean (p ^ e) (F + h ^ p ^ e) → h ^ p ^ e = 0

Singularity.purelyInseparable.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring k] → ℕ → MvPolynomial σ k → MvPolynomial (Option σ) k

Singularity.purelyInseparableHypersurfac.type: ∀ {p n : ℕ}, p ≠ 0 → Singularity.ResolutionInDim p n → Singularity.PurelyInseparableHypersurfaceResolution p n

Singularity.regularLocus_eq_univ_iff.type: ∀ (X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme), Singularity.regularLocus X = Set.univ ↔ Singularity.IsRegularScheme X

Singularity.regularLocus_isOpen_of_charZ.type:
∀ {k : Type u} [inst : Field k] [CharZero k] (X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme) (f : X ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec ↧k)
  [AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyOfFiniteType f], IsOpen (Singularity.regularLocus X)

Singularity.regularLocus_isOpen_of_field.type:
∀ {k : Type u} [inst : Field k] (X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme) (f : X ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec ↧k)
  [AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyOfFiniteType f], IsOpen (Singularity.regularLocus X)

Singularity.regularLocus_isOpen_of_perfe.type:
∀ {k : Type u} [inst : Field k] [PerfectField k] (X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme) (f : X ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec ↧k)
  [AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyOfFiniteType f], IsOpen (Singularity.regularLocus X)

Singularity.residualFactor.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring k] → Finset σ → MvPolynomial σ k → MvPolynomial σ k

Singularity.residualFactor_monomial_mul.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] {Δ : Finset σ} {r : σ →₀ ℕ} {G : MvPolynomial σ k},
  (∀ i ∉ Δ, r i = 0) →
    (∀ i ∈ Δ, ∃ d ∈ G.support, d i = 0) → Singularity.residualFactor Δ ((MvPolynomial.monomial r) 1 * G) = G

Singularity.residualOrder.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring k] → ℕ → MvPolynomial σ k → ℕ∞

Singularity.residualOrderAlong.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring k] → Finset σ → ℕ → MvPolynomial σ k → ℕ∞

Singularity.residualOrderAlong_add_pow.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar k p] (Δ : Finset σ) (e : ℕ)
  (F h : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.residualOrderAlong Δ (p ^ e) (F + h ^ p ^ e) = Singularity.residualOrderAlong Δ (p ^ e) F

Singularity.residualOrderAlong_empty.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (q : ℕ) (F : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.residualOrderAlong ∅ q F = Singularity.ord (Singularity.cleanPart q F)

Singularity.residualOrderAlong_eq.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] {Δ : Finset σ} {q : ℕ} {r : σ →₀ ℕ} {G : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.IsClean q ((MvPolynomial.monomial r) 1 * G) →
    (∀ i ∉ Δ, r i = 0) →
      (∀ i ∈ Δ, ∃ d ∈ G.support, d i = 0) →
        Singularity.residualOrderAlong Δ q ((MvPolynomial.monomial r) 1 * G) = Singularity.ord G

Singularity.residualOrder_add_pow.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar k p] (e : ℕ) (F h : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.residualOrder (p ^ e) (F + h ^ p ^ e) = Singularity.residualOrder (p ^ e) F

Singularity.residualOrder_eq_ord_cleanPa.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar k p] [PerfectRing k p] (e : ℕ)
  (F : MvPolynomial σ k), Singularity.residualOrder (p ^ e) F = Singularity.ord (Singularity.cleanPart (p ^ e) F)

Singularity.residualOrder_eq_ord_of_add_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar k p] (e : ℕ) {F h : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.IsClean (p ^ e) (F + h ^ p ^ e) → Singularity.residualOrder (p ^ e) F = Singularity.ord (F + h ^ p ^ e)

Singularity.residualOrder_eq_ord_of_isCl.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar k p] (e : ℕ) {F : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.IsClean (p ^ e) F → Singularity.residualOrder (p ^ e) F = Singularity.ord F

Singularity.residualOrder_le_ord_cleanPa.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar k p] (e : ℕ) (F : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.residualOrder (p ^ e) F ≤ Singularity.ord (Singularity.cleanPart (p ^ e) F)

Singularity.ringKrullDim_p1Ring_le.type:
∀ {k : Type u} [inst : Field k] {p n : ℕ},
  p ≠ 0 → ∀ (g : MvPolynomial (Fin n) k), ringKrullDim (Singularity.P1Ring k p n g) ≤ ↑n

Singularity.scaleVar_comp_rename.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (c : k),
  (MvPolynomial.aeval fun o => o.elim (MvPolynomial.C c * MvPolynomial.X none) fun i => MvPolynomial.X (some i)).comp
      (MvPolynomial.rename some) =
    MvPolynomial.rename some

Singularity.scaleVar_comp_translate.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (c : k) (v : σ → k),
  (MvPolynomial.aeval fun o => o.elim (MvPolynomial.C c * MvPolynomial.X none) fun i => MvPolynomial.X (some i)).comp
      (Singularity.translate v) =
    Singularity.translate (c • v)

Singularity.shiftVar_comp_rename.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (w : σ → k),
  (MvPolynomial.aeval fun o =>
          o.elim (MvPolynomial.X none) fun i =>
            MvPolynomial.X (some i) + MvPolynomial.C (w i) * MvPolynomial.X none).comp
      (MvPolynomial.rename some) =
    Singularity.translate w

Singularity.shiftVar_comp_translate.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (v w : σ → k),
  (MvPolynomial.aeval fun o =>
          o.elim (MvPolynomial.X none) fun i =>
            MvPolynomial.X (some i) + MvPolynomial.C (w i) * MvPolynomial.X none).comp
      (Singularity.translate v) =
    Singularity.translate (v + w)

Singularity.stalkIdeal_eq_top_of_notMem.type: ∀ {Z : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} {I : Z.IdealSheafData} {z : ↥Z}, z ∉ I.support → Singularity.stalkIdeal I z = ⊤

Singularity.stalkIdeal_le_maximalIdeal.type:
∀ {Z : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} {I : Z.IdealSheafData} {z : ↥Z},
  z ∈ I.support → Singularity.stalkIdeal I z ≤ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↑(Z.presheaf.stalk z)

Singularity.stalkIdeal_ne_top_iff.type: ∀ {Z : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} {I : Z.IdealSheafData} {z : ↥Z}, Singularity.stalkIdeal I z ≠ ⊤ ↔ z ∈ I.support

Singularity.stalkIdeal_vanishingIdeal_si.type:
∀ {Z : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} {z : ↥Z} (hz : IsClosed {z}),
  Singularity.stalkIdeal (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal { carrier := {z}, isClosed' := hz })
      z =
    IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↑(Z.presheaf.stalk z)

Singularity.strictTransform.type: {Z Z' : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} → Z.IdealSheafData → (Z' ⟶ Z) → Z.Opens → Z'.IdealSheafData

Singularity.topologicalKrullDim_p1Hypers.type:
∀ {k : Type u} [inst : Field k] {p n : ℕ},
  p ≠ 0 → ∀ (g : MvPolynomial (Fin n) k), topologicalKrullDim ↥(Singularity.P1Hypersurface k p n g) ≤ ↑n

Singularity.totalDegree_aeval_le.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {φ : σ → MvPolynomial σ k},
  (∀ (i : σ), (φ i).totalDegree ≤ 1) → ∀ (p : MvPolynomial σ k), ((MvPolynomial.aeval φ) p).totalDegree ≤ p.totalDegree

Singularity.totalDegree_chartRest_le.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k) (p : MvPolynomial σ k),
  ((Singularity.chartRest j t) p).totalDegree ≤ p.totalDegree

Singularity.totalDegree_chartShift_le.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k) (p : MvPolynomial σ k),
  ((Singularity.chartShift j t) p).totalDegree ≤ p.totalDegree

Singularity.translate.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → (σ → k) → MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial (Option σ) k

Singularity.translate_zero.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k], Singularity.translate 0 = MvPolynomial.rename some

Singularity.weightedOrd.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → (σ → ℕ) → MvPolynomial σ R → ℕ∞

Singularity.weightedOrd_eq_top_iff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {w : σ → ℕ} {f : MvPolynomial σ R},
  Singularity.weightedOrd w f = ⊤ ↔ f = 0

Singularity.weightedOrd_le.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {w : σ → ℕ} {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {d : σ →₀ ℕ},
  f.coeff d ≠ 0 → Singularity.weightedOrd w f ≤ ↑((Finsupp.weight w) d)

Singularity.weightedOrd_mul.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] (w : σ → ℕ) (f g : MvPolynomial σ R),
  Singularity.weightedOrd w (f * g) = Singularity.weightedOrd w f + Singularity.weightedOrd w g

Singularity.weightedOrd_one.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  Singularity.weightedOrd (fun x => 1) f = Singularity.ord f

Singularity.zShift.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} →
    [inst : CommSemiring k] → MvPolynomial σ k → MvPolynomial (Option σ) k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial (Option σ) k

Singularity.zShift_purelyInseparable.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar k p] (e : ℕ) (h F : MvPolynomial σ k),
  (Singularity.zShift h) (Singularity.purelyInseparable (p ^ e) F) =
    Singularity.purelyInseparable (p ^ e) (F + h ^ p ^ e)

Singularity.zShift_rename.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (h F : MvPolynomial σ k),
  (Singularity.zShift h) ((MvPolynomial.rename some) F) = (MvPolynomial.rename some) F
